T2HELIX IMPLEMENTATION MAP — SIX CONCERNS RAISED PRE-CANONIZATION by this session (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=ed939196-7260-42f2-aa22-3b75fe3db422) on 2026-05-10 evening. Paired with map insight at domain t2helix,implementation-map,phase-0-through-5,lineage-letter,session-attributed recorded same evening. Two integrated into the map text; four ride along as inline annotations in their relevant phases.

INTEGRATED INTO MAP (Flags 1 and 5):

Flag 1 — Pre-registration brittleness (Phase 0.1). OSF/AsPredicted locks thresholds before the data exists to calibrate them. ≥30 shadow fires + ≥7 days + ≥30-day evidence span at solo-developer scale may take 3–6 months, not 30 days. If pre-reg becomes pressure to produce data that doesn't yet exist, it inverts the methodology. Resolution integrated: each primary threshold pre-registered alongside an explicit sparse-data provision (alternative analysis activated if observed N falls below threshold within evaluation window). Pre-reg with provisions IS still rigorous; pre-reg without them is brittle. Loop-specific provisions detailed in map.

Flag 5 — Cascade cap framing (Phase 4.4). Original draft said 'Any single pattern_id can seed at most 1 compass candidate OR 1 self-model observation, never both.' Reads as absolute exclusion, but legitimate cross-cutting patterns (e.g., 'user prefers explicit error messages') want to inform BOTH compass and self-model. Resolution integrated: '≤1 per downstream loop, ≤2 globally per pattern_id.' Preserves widen-don't-flip (no single observation dominates multiple downstream effects) without over-restricting cross-cutting patterns. Enforced via reflector_cascade_audit table at proposal time.

RIDING ALONG AS INLINE ANNOTATIONS (Flags 2, 4, 6):

Flag 2 — Detached worker in Stop hook (Phase 3.4). worker.unref() lets parent exit but worker still runs in some process tree. If Claude Code's session-close kills child processes, worker dies mid-extraction. Cleaner design: queue-file pattern. Stop hook writes transcript path + session_id to queue file in data dir. Next UserPromptSubmit (any session, any time) drains the queue synchronously before returning context. Survives 'claude --print' and one-shot invocations cleanly. Flagged inline in Phase 3.4 of map.

Flag 3 — Citation detection threshold (Phase 2.1). Levenshtein ≥0.85 on 4–5 word ngrams is stated number, not empirically calibrated. Risk: brittle on real paraphrase, permissive on coincidence. Suggested mitigation: Phase 2 ships with both heuristic AND small-embedding (xenova/transformers MiniLM, local, no API cost) running in parallel for the first month, then Phase 2.5 or 3 picks calibrated winner from real data. Not yet integrated into map text — should be considered before Phase 2 implementation begins.

Flag 4 — Phase 4 cost target (Phase 4.5). $0.30/year claim assumes specific token budgets not shown. Quick math at Haiku 4.5 pricing ($0.80/$4 per M, with 50% Batch discount and cache hits): 52 weekly passes × ~5K cached input + ~3K output ≈ $0.40/year before cache savings. Achievable but tight. Resolution: model the token budget explicitly in Phase 0 alongside pre-registration so the target either holds or gets revised before public commitment. Flagged inline in Phase 4.5.

Flag 6 — Timeline buffer. 40 weeks at 5 hrs/week = 200 hours assumes no rework, no architecture revisions, no setbacks. For novel solo work with research throughline, 1.5–2x is honest. 60–80 weeks to all-four-loops-live. Naming it now prevents the schedule from being read as contract against the work later. Flagged inline in Realistic Timeline section.

Layer: hypothesis. Concerns reflect this session's reading; future sessions executing against the map may sharpen or dissolve them as Phase work reveals which were calibrated correctly.
